cull1dot.title: TRACKB / cull1dot — pure deletion of isolated 1-dot singletons (<550 m)
cull1dot.hypothesis: R0's 3,349 isolated 1-dot singletons (8.894% of R0; zero R0 neighbours within 550 m) cannot form >= 1 km Phase 2 fault traces and represent localized geophysical/topographic speckles whose expected truth coverage sits below the DTI isolated-dot inclusion bar c = 0.2 * DTI (~0.0556); deleting them while keeping 100% of multi-dot chains and >= 1 km traces trims false-positive denominator weight without eroding trace recall.
cull1dot.mechanism: Surface-rupturing and range-bounding normal/oblique faults in the Great Basin scale at L >> 500 m across 100 m GeoDAWN pixels. An unlinked 1-dot island in a d=2.83 px ridge-thinned network marks a sub-550 m local gradient spike rather than a continuous fault plane. Under DTI = T / (0.2T + 0.2(S - M) + 0.8|G|), setting delta_S = -3,349 reduces 0.2*(S - M) while preserving 100% of R0's >= 1 km traces.
cull1dot.mimicking_non_fault_process: Small volcanic plugs/cones, isolated mafic erosional knobs, talus aprons, stock-pond berms, or single-line airborne survey tie-line levelling spikes (which make cull1dot help); conversely, short bedrock windows of real buried range-front faults peeking through thick piedmont alluvium (which make cull1dot hurt).
cull1dot.predicted_sign: near-zero / slightly positive (+0.0010 MODEL; below 0.01 evidence floor)
cull1dot.falsifier: Live delta <= -0.010 falsifies singleton noise-dominance and proves R0's isolated dots capture real segmented or alluvium-masked fault windows above the 0.2*DTI bar.
cull1dot.form_note_template: R0 TRACKB cull1dot: drop {removed} isolated 1-dot speckles (<550m); keep 100% >=1km traces

bridge1km.title: TRACKB / bridge1km — count-fixed kernel-spaced gap bridging & tip extension on >= 1 km traces
bridge1km.hypothesis: Reallocating R0's 3,349 isolated 1-dot singletons (17.788% of R0 cells changed, total mass fixed at 37,654) into internal > 300 m kernel blind spots and 320 m collinear tip steps along R0's strike-consistent >= 1 km traces converts sub-bar isolated mass into contiguous along-strike fault coverage without paying sub-kernel overlap tax.
bridge1km.mechanism: Along R0's 2,808 >= 1 km strike-consistent traces, vertex spacings of 566-750 m leave triangular-kernel saddle blind spots (k(d)=0 at 300 m), while range-front fault tips step beneath young fan alluvium just past R0's thinning cutoff. Inserting relocated dots at internal gap midpoints first and 320 m/640 m collinear tip steps second strictly preserves R0's 2.8284 px spacing floor and > 300 m catalogue clearance, raising T and M along coherent fault zones at fixed S = 37,654.
bridge1km.mimicking_non_fault_process: Resistant welded ash-flow tuff hogbacks, linear Miocene basalt flow margins, Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shorelines (<1,360 m), and straight piedmont road/canal grades form multi-kilometre colinear ridges; bridging and extending them concentrates mass onto linear non-fault landforms.
bridge1km.predicted_live_change: +0.0020 MODEL (band -0.0030..+0.0070; <0.01 Phase 1 floor; Phase 2 trace-completion arm)
bridge1km.predicted_sign: small positive (+0.0020 MODEL; primary Track B count-fixed hybrid candidate)
bridge1km.falsifier: Live delta <= -0.010, or live delta worse than cull1dot on the identical singleton pool, falsifies >= 1 km trace bridging/tip-extension and shows relocated mass walked onto linear volcanic/shoreline/erosional mimics.
bridge1km.form_note_template: R0 TRACKB bridge1km: move {removed} 1-dot speckles to >=1km trace gaps/tips; S=37654

rendertop120.title: TRACKB / rendertop120 — continuous 100 m polyline rasterisation of top-120 GeoJSON traces
rendertop120.hypothesis: Rasterising the top-120 multi-physics-corroborated >= 1 km GeoJSON geologist traces as unbroken 8-connected 100 m polylines (+1,518 Bresenham connector pixels funded 1-for-1 by removing 1,518 weakest isolated singletons; 8.063% of R0 changed, S = 37,654) delivers unmistakable continuous fault traces for Phase 2 expert review while keeping the Phase 1 DTI sub-kernel overlap tax inside +/-0.005.
rendertop120.mechanism: Under NLR-RULES, ONE blind final GeoTIFF is scored in both Phase 1 (automated DTI) and Phase 2 (expert geologist trace review + expanded reference labels). Pure trace-only rasters fail Phase 1 recall, whereas d=2.83 px dot chains appear discontinuous at 100 m pixel scale. Continuous Bresenham rendering on only the top-120 >= 1 km traces (4.03% of R0's mass budget) synchronises the raster pixel-for-pixel with the GeoJSON geologist dossier while preserving 96.0% of R0's kernel-spaced background coverage.
rendertop120.mimicking_non_fault_process: Adjacent 100 m pixels along rendered traces share 67-83% of their R=300 m triangular kernel discs (deliberate Phase 1 overlap tax), and any strike-parallel volcanic dike, tuff cliff, or pluvial shoreline inside the top-120 receives 2.2x denser unit mass per km than background R0 chains.
rendertop120.predicted_live_change: -0.0005 MODEL (band -0.0050..+0.0030; Phase 1 neutral, Phase 2 geologist-legibility arm)
rendertop120.predicted_sign: Phase 1 neutral / slight overlap tax (-0.0005 MODEL; Phase 2 review arm)
rendertop120.falsifier: Phase 1 live delta <= -0.010 falsifies continuous 100 m trace rendering even at a 4% mass budget; Phase 2 geologist audit rejecting > 50% of the 120 GeoJSON traces as volcanic flow margins, hogbacks, or pluvial shorelines falsifies the ranking composite.
